capabilities: access book notes in one place
extras: Setup and usage instructions live in separate external documentation, not the README. The author states pull requests are not accepted and that no generative AI tools were used to write the code.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to organize book notes or track reading progress and habits across a vault.
summary: Book and reading tracker that keeps all book notes in one place, tracks reading progress, and shows reading habits.
